name: text
title: Text
description: Named type roles for body copy, labels, captions and headings on the brand scale. Text uses text-body, text-label, text-supporting, text-caption and text-display; code stays relative at 0.92em within its parent. Heading sizes display, xl, lg, md, sm, xs and 2xs use text-display and text-heading-* independently of semantic level 1–6 (level 2 defaults to text-heading-lg). Eleven roles come from typography.css, also exported as DTCG typography, Figma type/* variables and typeScale with pixel dimensions and unitless leading. font-*, leading-* and tracking-* utilities override role defaults; body, supporting and caption inherit weight and tracking. A font-size className such as text-[32px] replaces the entire role, including its leading, weight and tracking: unlike the previous separate variant classes, those defaults no longer remain. Supply explicit utilities when needed, for example text-[32px] font-bold tracking-tight for display, text-[12px] font-medium leading-tight for label, or text-[16px] font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug for Heading. Both components support contrast-safe tones, truncation, line clamping and as / render.
